# Make Good Happen

> Make Good Happen helps charities engage with the outside world. We offer fundraising, communications and advocacy, and executive counsel for the people leading charities. We run entire fundraising functions. We offer advice and strategic support to executive teams. We have the range from delivery to strategy. We are fun, friendly, honest and dedicated. We can be trusted with the most significant relationships an organisations holds. 
## What we do

- **Fundraising**: strategy, consultancy and hands-on delivery for charities.
- **Comms and advocacy**: getting your cause heard by supporters, the media and decision-makers.
- **Executive counsel**: consultancy support for charity CEOs and executives, and support for founders.

## How we work

- Strategy
- Consultancy
- Hands-on delivery
